columns.name: domain
columns.description: Lowercase URL hostname, leading www. removed

columns.name: text
columns.description: Full source HTML text, untrusted; render as text, not HTML

order: time DESC, id DESC; missing time last

source.name: Hacker News official Firebase API
source.selection: The newest 1,000,000 item IDs (stories, comments, jobs, polls, pollopts) by consecutive ID ending at maxitem; every id fetched, none missing/null/errored
source.completeness_limitations: Snapshot: score, descendants and dead/deleted flags are as of fetch time; very recent items may later change. Items are by ID, so 'posts' includes comments (about 84% comments). Credential-shaped strings (4 found: API keys etc.) were replaced with [REDACTED-SECRET] in text fields before publishing (scripts/redact_secrets.py); all else is verbatim.
source.selection_after_daily_update: latest retained items by time DESC, id DESC; all item types; unavailable IDs retried

daily_update.mode: daily additions since last successful scan; catch-up included
daily_update.score_policy: snapshot at first retrieval; older scores/comments are not refreshed
daily_update.redaction_policy: credential-shaped strings in text/title/url replaced using scripts/redact_secrets.py
